producer_report.summary:
I wrote the scope-guard design, a proposed D127 and a changelog line. It is docs only, with no code or config changes. `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo test --locked --quiet` both pass. I did not run clippy.

- **Mapping:** I confirmed it against the BRIEF.md pantheon rows. Artemis owns the role, and Demeter supplies the cost side of its test. Hestia keeps knowledge and does not gate work.
- **Value versus cost:** value inputs each need a source; cost inputs are labeled measured or estimate. A decision table covers queue, merge, defer and drop.
- **Thrash signals:** there are five, T1 to T5, with thresholds. Every threshold is labeled an estimate to be tuned, except that the $2.50-per-landed-job ceiling in T3 comes from `job-planning.md` section 9.
- **Replay:** the same-criterion signal (T4) fires after the second speedup rejection, before the third attempt. The 60-minute wall-time signal fires on the prompt-budget trap, 20 minutes before the 80 spent. Cut A, with three different causes, is flagged but not paused. Cost splits across attempts assume an even split.
- **Rules versus model:** code decides the signals and the table. The model only scores inputs and can only move a decision toward asking Sri. A list says what it may not override.
- **Powers:** the guard may defer, merge exact duplicates, and pause a line (never kill it). Dropping, re-scoping and governance changes go to Sri through the steward channel.
- **Learnings work:** it has a protected quota (at least 25% of improvement dispatches in any 20, an estimate), proceeds on doubt, and can be appealed.
- **Relations:** the design also covers the steward, Hestia and the planning keep rule, and models its own keep rule on that one.
- **Build plan:** ten jobs, each with scope, files, dependency and an acceptance check.
- **D127 and changelog:** D127 follows D126, marked proposed, and links the design. The changelog has an Unreleased entry under Added.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/scope-guard.md states the value-versus-cost test: value side names failure class, goal or product need, and how often it bites, each with a source; cost side gives expected dollars and wall time labeled measured or estimate; a decision rule says when work is queued, merged, deferred or dropped.
criteria_check.evidence: Sections 3.1 to 3.3 of the new file: value table with a source column, cost table with measured/estimate labels, decision table for queue, merge, defer, drop.

criteria_check.criterion: The design grounds itself in the record with these figures, each labeled as supplied by the request (records/ not visible to the producer) unless a repository source is cited: trailer job, three rejected attempts and about 11 dollars before the split; about 80 minutes lost to the prompt-budget trap; 49 open requests, many done or superseded; test-suite speedup, three rejected attempts (jobs 20261025-190606-eebk, 20261025-202447-xgk9, 20261025-214509-y179, about 9 dollars and 4 hours), each a real gain (test check about 12 to 7.4-7.8 minutes) but rejected for missing a fixed time target set without a measurement showing it reachable, then landed by narrowed request 20261025-230352-ph40; cut A took four tries (timing race, wait on wrong check, duplicate push-triggered runs).
criteria_check.evidence: Section 4 lists every figure, each marked (request) or citing D125/D126 as read.

criteria_check.criterion: Thrash signals have numeric thresholds with stated basis or an 'estimate, to be tuned' label, covering repeated retries, growing plans, cost against forecast p90, and a line of work rejected twice for the same unmet criterion; the document shows which signals would have fired on the trailer job, the speedup and the prompt-budget trap.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 5 table T1 to T5 with basis and effect; section 5.1 replay table, T4 fires after the 2nd speedup rejection, T5 fires at 60 min on the prompt-budget trap; unknowns stated as such.

criteria_check.criterion: The design separates rules (code decides) from model judgment, says why, and what a model verdict may not override.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 6: code list, model list, why, and an explicit 'may not' list.

criteria_check.criterion: Powers are listed: what it can stop or merge on its own, what is advisory, what goes to Sri and through which channel; learnings work (BRIEF.md addendum 2026-10-25) is not blocked, via a protected quota, default-to-proceed on doubt, and an appeal path.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 8 has three lists plus the steward channel; section 7 has quota (25% in 20), default-to-proceed, appeal with 7 day timer.

criteria_check.criterion: The document states its relation to the steward, Hestia and the planning keep rule (job-planning.md section 9), and confirms or changes the Artemis/Demeter mapping against the BRIEF.md pantheon table with reasons.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 2 quotes the BRIEF.md rows (lines 603-607) and confirms with reasons; section 9 covers steward, Hestia, keep rule; section 10 models its keep rule on it.

criteria_check.criterion: The document has a numbered build plan of jobs, each sized for one producer run with scope, files touched and an acceptance check, ordered by dependency; no code is written.
criteria_check.evidence: Section 13, jobs 1 to 10, each with Scope, Files, Depends, Acceptance; only markdown changed.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md gains D127 after D126, marked proposed, in the existing format (Case, Decision, alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost), linking to the design; CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased entry naming the design and the proposed decision.
criteria_check.evidence: D127 appended after D126 with Status proposed, Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance and a link; CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added entry added.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test` and `cargo fmt --check`: any tests checking decisions numbering, docs inventory or changelog format still pass.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test --locked --quiet (all ok) and cargo fmt --all --check (clean).

open_issues: All thresholds and the 25% quota are estimates; the 49 open requests figure, and the done or superseded split, are request-supplied and unchecked.
Replay cells for T2 and some T3/T4 cases are 'not known' because records were not visible.
I did not run clippy (docs-only change).
mistakes: Cost splits in the replay table assume an even split across attempts; labeled as an estimate, but not measured.
learnings: D126 was the last decision heading; D127 is free.
CHANGELOG has many '### Added' headings, so edits need surrounding context to be unique.
Tests passed with the new design file present; no docs-inventory check failed.
desires: Read access to records/ to measure the baseline wasted share and the real per-attempt costs.
